long_description: VibeFlow is the AI content manager, that hands-off creates and manages viral social content for startup founders and growth teams, saving them hours and delivering qualified leads.  Existing AI tools spit out generic, off-brand content you can't really use. VibeFlow learns your brand, voice, and goals, then autonomously creates on-brand, tailored posts (with visuals) ready to publish.
name: VibeFlow
one_liner: AI content manager that grows your company's online presence
